book.name: 1 Tasoloni
book.title: Lepran Ɗenshee Ɗǝ Pool Ran Nenyil Tasolonǝ mo

content: Dak Pool Tasolonika
Ɗyemnaa mo, wun wu man shikáa fuu nee, jì fun pee wun ɗe baa nǝ a buu kas.

Wu man kaaɗe mun mu ten mu shwaajee kǝ fǝlǝp nɗǝǝn yil nFilipi, akuɗang muu jì pee wun ɗe nTasolonǝ. Koo ɗe gyet gurum mo ɗes mmo cii mun, ɗangɓe Naan fun wur shínɓal mmun mputuup, mbǝkǝ mǝ satpwoo wur ɗeret nǝ ɗe nwun.
Pwoo ɗe mu sat nwun nǝ, baa nǝ a ɗung koo pan ɗebish kas. Baa gyet mǝ sat nǝ, a mbǝkǝ mǝ gwam mee gurum ɗe kas.
Amma mbǝɗe Naan wur kǝ ten bǝlǝp mun, kǝ wur kǝ ten le pwoo nwur nǝ nɗǝǝn sar wur. Muu cìn kǝ mǝ tong ɗyeen ɗǝ a nNaan, ɗewur man pǝtuup fun mo jir. Baa muu cìn mbǝkǝ mutong ɗyeen ɗe a ngurum kas.
Wu man nǝ, baa muu kam jì kǝ mee pwoo ɗeshang mmee gurum shi lǝpwoo fun mo kas, mbǝkǝ mǝ gwam wun, kǝ mǝ kat shool ɗe pee wun kas. Naan wu man nǝ aasǝ.
Baa muu cam tang a ɗeɗes pee gurum mo ɗe kas, koo pǝ wun, koo pee nenɗeci mo. Koo ɗi mun kǝ pee mɓe cìn ɗak kǝ iiko fun kaa nenlep Kristi mo sǝ.
Dangɓe jir kǝsǝ, ɓe gyet muu fwang wun, a kaaɗe nǝǝn kyee war fwang jep war mo sǝ.
Mbǝɗe mǝ wal nwun zam, har gyet mu rǝɓet mbǝkǝ mǝ shin seen fun mo mɓe wun, baa a mɓe pwoo ɗeret Naan ɗe gyet mǝ sat nwun ɓejee kas.
Ɗyemnaa mo, wu yee nɗak ɗe gyet mun mu cìn shiɓal pee wun ɗi. Gyet mun mu cìn ɗak mpar kǝ puus, mbǝkǝ taji mu lejeel nwun kas, nnaar ɗe gyet mun nkaa satpwoo ɗeret mǝ Naan nǝ nwun.
Wun a langtǝng fun, kǝ Naan zak, Gyet shiimwaan fun mo mbǝ wun ɗi, wun ɗe wu shinzeen nǝ a ɗeɓang, ɗeret ɗang nii mee luk kas.
Wu man nee, mu tap wun a kaaɗe puun kǝ tap jep nwur mo sǝ.

Muu caa wun, muu ɓam wun zak, kǝzak, mun kǝ sat nǝ yit ɗes nǝ, nǝ ret kǝ wun mwaan a mwaan ɗe nǝ ret nNaan nyit. Naan ɗewur pǝrep wun, mbǝkǝ wu ɗel ɗe nɗǝǝn mulki nwur, kǝ mǝ tong ɗe ashak kǝ wur nɗǝǝn ram fin.

Mee mbii ɗe nii le, kǝ mu pǝlang Naan shidaar-shidaar zak, gyet mǝ shee satpwoo Naan nǝ nwun, ɓe kaaɗe wu kǝleng, ɓe wu lap nǝ, baa a kaa pwoo gurum sǝ kas, amma wu lap nǝ a kaa pwoo Naan sǝ ɗang nǝ a pwoo nǝ azeen, ɗe nǝ nkaa cìn ɗak nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fuu mo, wun nen ɗe wu cinzeen.
Ɗyemnaa fun mo, wu mwaan nɗǝǝn shiimwaan nenɗǝm ndang Naan ɗe mo a mǝ Kristi Jesu, ɗe mo nɗǝǝn yil nJudiya. Wuu nshwaajeel nsar nenyil fuu mo, kaaɗe gyet mu shwaajeel nsar nen Yahudi mo sǝ.
Gyet a nen Yahudi nǝ mo tu Daa Jesu, kǝ mo twe nensatpwoo Naan mo. Mo ceen mun zak. Baa mbii ɗe mo cìn nǝ ret nNaan nyit kas koo lee. Kǝzak, mo a shaarlek gurum mo jir.

Mbǝɗe moo yaappee, mbǝkǝ mo cíi satpwoo ɗeret nǝ ɗe mmun, mɓe nen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas, mbǝkǝ taji mo kat seen ɗe zak. A nɗǝǝn ar ɗesi ɓe, mo gam shi ɓutbish fur ɗe moo naa ncìn nǝ, amma yaksǝ tuup Naan nii taa nkaa mo jir.
Pool Rǝɓet Waa Dǝm nYil nTasoloni
Ɗyemnaa mo, kaaɗe gyet mu ɓàkshak kǝ wun, mɓe rep pee lee, yaksǝ nǝ daampee mmun, koo ɗe a yit fun mo ɓàkshak ɗak, ɓe pǝtuup fun moo pan wun ɗe shidaar-shidaar.
Ɗyeen mmun naa yit fuu mo zam. Muu fes mǝ rǝɓet dǝm pee wun ɗe zam. An Pool, kǝ lepan fen mbǝ dǝm pee wun ɗi met nyitvǝl, amma nGujwaan ɗar a ar nǝ.
A me a mbii canciin fun, kǝ retnyit fun, ɗe nǝ kám nnǝ, muu se koorong nyit Daa fun Jesu, parpuus ɗewur mbaajì yii? Baa a wun kas aa?
A wun a nen ɗe wu le kǝ mu kat retyit kǝ nǝ nshang mmun parpuus ɗe mun nnaa Jesu Kristi.
